item.title: Venus is 2.8 times hotter than Mercury, despite Mercury bein…
item.author: altNOAA 🇺🇸 (@altnoaa.bsky.social)
item.description:
Venus is 2.8 times hotter than Mercury, despite Mercury being closer to the Sun. Why? Venus' atmosphere is primarily CO2, which traps heat.

So what happens when we add CO2 to our atmosphere? It traps heat.

This shouldn't be that difficult to understand.

item.title: You know, when you find out that the art you like is made by…
item.author: John Scalzi (@scalzi.com)
item.description: You know, when you find out that the art you like is made by people you've learned hold views you find wholly repugnant, I don't think you need to disavow ever having enjoyed the art. It's okay to acknowledge you liked or loved that art, but are now putting it aside. That was then, this is now.
